limits: This check verifies frozen judgments and aggregation, not a new semantic annotation.
Root paired defect-target metrics cover consumer findings only. Raw verdict/rationale defects are separately recomputed here; cross-contract baseline has no analogous extra raw surface.
Diagnostic target sets are not a full prose-equivalence or causal-effect test.
Contract-visible, hint-mode-blind same-family review; dependent pairs and repeats, separate cohorts.
Malformed raw strings are inspected only as labeled diagnostics, never repaired into applied output.
